matched_sweep.analysis_basis: Arithmetic means computed directly from all 30 native response timings.predicted_per_second, not the rounded client.json/result.json summaries. Comparison is within the same prompt and n_max only.
matched_sweep.acceptance_rule: gain = candidate - max(off, off-b); spread = abs(off - off-b); require gain > spread, plus full generated text and proposed/accepted draft counters equal within the same prompt and n_max.
matched_sweep.request_validation: All 30 native responses report temperature=0, ignore_eos=true, max_tokens=300, predicted_n=tokens_predicted=300, stopped_limit=true, truncated=false, and full prompt_n=tokens_evaluated of 1532/2210/2009. Exact authenticated client requests cache_prompt=false and prompt-major ordering; client.log confirms all 30 phase/prompt pairs; server.log has 32 zero-start KV resets and 32 completion requests including two warm-ups.
matched_sweep.restoration: At 2026-10-22T03:45:04.828994+00:00: exact collected unit success/status0/not-found/inactive/dead; six exact timers active/waiting; all 293 still-live saved task IDs match saved affinity, 13 exited, none inaccessible; co-tenants8097/8094 HTTP200, numa_balancing2, demotiontrue, swap /dev/nvme0n1p2, interleave1/1/1. Native log reports 298 old tasks restored plus 8 born-window tasks freed to40CPUs. Born-window custody is native-log evidence, not a new broad process scan.
matched_sweep.next_atom: Parent records the result in its source/task state and decides any later dedicated replication. No split24 load: split16 is below split12 in both modes and all three prompts. No default change.
limitations: One matched sweep on three coding-agent briefs; within-run criterion only, not a statistical confidence interval or broad capability/quality result.
Split8 and split12 are not separable by the aggregate off-control spread in either mode; do not turn their rounded tie into a clear winner.
Prompt2 differs between n4 and n0; cross-mode text identity is not required and no cross-mode speed/quality conclusion is made.
Native server build commit is unknown and knobs.src_sha is empty; provenance comes from the package SOURCE_SHA, observed binary SHA256, launch journal, and authenticated staged scripts.

All 26 native tier snapshots and all 32 DSpark statistics lines are retained in the complete private server.log. No terminal tier-total line was emitted; last ctl-before counters precede the last off0b request, so they are not whole-run totals.
